definitions: Small, often round pieces of material, such as glass, plastic, or wood, that are pierced through the middle and can be threaded together to make necklaces, bracelets, etc.
A drop of liquid, such as sweat or rain, that forms on a surface.
examples: She wore a necklace of colourful beads.
The beads of sweat ran down his face.
He counted the beads on the abacus.
